title: Extended Documents Due Date Under the Patient Financial Assistance Program: Calculation of the Extension Days
content:
**Rule.** When the documents due date on a Patient Financial Assistance Program case is extended, the extended due date is the current documents due date plus the extension days. The extension days are the tier's document extension days, counted in calendar days from the current documents due date.

**Terms.** The current documents due date is the documents due date the case records at the time of the extension. The extension days are a number of calendar days; the current documents due date is day 0 of that count, and the extended due date is the day whose number equals the extension days.

## Illustration (hypothetical figure of 10 extension days, used here only to show the count)

| | Date |
|---|---|
| Current documents due date (day 0) | Monday 12 October 2026 |
| Day 1 | Tuesday 13 October 2026 |
| Extended due date (day 10) | Thursday 22 October 2026 |

The count starts from the current documents due date, not from the day the extension is asked for: an extension asked for on 1 October with the same current due date of 12 October gives the same extended due date of 22 October.
